name: 92879 · Corona, CA
findings: ZIP 92879 (Corona) has 156 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92879 (Corona) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92879 (Corona) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
